option_b.note: estimates from the region_clock stage model (UNCHECKED); pessimism = flat OCV of die_ci_margins.json on the non-common delay (cell share 0.67 TT); CPPR removes only the common part, so a shorter tree ABOVE the last common node changes insertion but not a seam's pessimism

B1_stronger_drive.what: 2x BUFx24 per stage (BUFx24 is the largest ASAP7 buffer) or wider/2W shielded M9: per-stage delay -10..-20 % (assumed, not calibrated)

B2_fewer_levels.what: no zig-zag / no padding: die input -> farthest entry at the Manhattan radius 26823 um with n_min stages (lower bound of any single-input tree)

B3_per_quadrant_inputs.what: 4 package clock inputs at the depth-2 lattice nodes (quadrant roots); insertion = quadrant root -> entry
B3_per_quadrant_inputs.residual_pessimism_intra_quadrant: unchanged (CPPR already removes the shared part above the common node)
B3_per_quadrant_inputs.mesochronous: YES: the 4 inputs share no on-die node; their package/PLL distribution skew is uncontrolled and non-common, so every seam whose common node was the die root or a depth-1 lattice node becomes mesochronous and needs a landed hop anyway

B3b_per_region_inputs.what: 16 inputs at the lattice leaves; insertion = region only
B3b_per_region_inputs.mesochronous: YES: all die_root + lattice seams (= the OPTION A set) become mesochronous -> landing

budgets.basis: zero-logic pin-register seam pair, DFFHQNx1 (die_ci_margins.json lib), 60/25 ps uncertainty (AGENTS.md), xtalk_default; data wire delay ignored

option_a.rule: landed/forwarded hop on every seam whose last common clock node is the die root or a lattice node (owner 10-16/10-18 landed-regions standard: registered both sides, fixed static latency, no credits); balanced trees inside each lattice region (region_clock --region-only: no die-wide padding)
option_a.land_cycles_basis: QC landing ring component gate +3 (codex/qc-landing-1026 handoff, UNCHECKED here); +2 = the one-edge ledger's low case

ring_ff_bound.note: 4-slot ring per landed bit: ~4 x bits storage FF + read reg (ring inventory: codex canonical rings 86320 FF for 65 data + 5 monitor rings)

option_a.per_layer_note: per-layer delta = LAND_CYCLES x (landed crossings on the layer's serial critical chain); the chain is TOK-QK's (QCLM per-layer DAG); paths_by_landed_crossings gives the per-path counts to compose
